mechanism_narrative: ERBB2-MET forced-proximity novokine with GS_med linker (~20 A) biases signaling by enabling transphosphorylation between ERBB2 and MET kinase domains, which recruits SHC1-GRB2-SOS1 and GAB1-PI3K adaptor complexes to drive MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways. PLCG1 is sterically excluded because ERBB2 lacks the canonical PLCG1 docking site (Y992/1173 equivalent) and the forced geometry prevents MET's PLCG1-recruitment motif from being accessible to the ERBB2 kinase. STAT3 is activated via MET's direct Y1349/Y1356 multisubstrate docking site (cis-phosphorylation). The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a younger transcriptional phenotype by upregulating proliferation/survival genes (MYC, CCND1, DUSP6, ETV4) and downregulating senescence/inflammatory markers (TXNIP, IL32, S100A4, LGALS3).
